name: 91501 · Burbank, CA
findings: ZIP 91501 (Burbank) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91501 (Burbank) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 91501 (Burbank) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
